note: Two EXAMPLES. Write one requirement for every task of your process: node check-docs.js lists the tasks that still have none.

functional.statement: The system shall list the missing fields when a customer submits a request without a customer id, an item id, a quantity or a date.
acceptance: Given a request without a quantity, when the customer submits it, then the system lists quantity as missing and creates no request.
Given a complete request, when the customer submits it, then the system accepts it and gives it a request number.

functional.statement: The system shall mark the stock check as failed when the stock of the item is lower than the requested quantity.
acceptance: Given the Laptop has 0 in stock, when a request asks for 1 Laptop, then the stock check fails and names the stock.
Given the Projector has 5 in stock, when a request asks for 2 Projectors, then the stock check passes.
